hyperparameters.name: data_augmentation
hyperparameters.value: small random brightness and contrast jittering

methods.name: data augmentation
methods.description: random horizontal and vertical flipping, random rotation of 10 degrees, and small random brightness and contrast jittering

methods.name: ResNet34 one-hot
methods.description: Uses a standard approach for categorical classification, predicting masking levels independently using standard softmax and cross-entropy loss to predict one-hot encodings.

methods.name: ResNet34 multi-hot
methods.description: Accounts for the ordinal relation between masking levels using multi-hot encodings, training a model with multi-hot encoding could be seen as multi-label classification.

methods.name: Task 1
methods.description: Identifying low- and high-masking mammograms, considering the two lowest masking levels (1 and 2) as low-masking levels, and the two highest ones (7 and 8) as high-masking levels.

methods.name: Task 2
methods.description: Measuring the correlation between predicted masking estimates and certain cancers, specifically interval cancers and large invasive cancers, using AUC for individual cancer types and composite endpoint (CEP).

methods.name: 5-fold cross-validation
methods.description: used to determine the stopping iteration

methods.name: Ordinal classification
methods.description: modeling the median expert opinion of masking potential level in the range [1-8]

methods.name: odds ratio computation
methods.description: Compute the odds ratio of having interval cancer in different quartiles of model predictions relative to the first quartile.

methods.name: conversion of discrete masking predictions
methods.description: Convert discrete masking predictions to continuous values by computing a weighted average of probabilities.
